name: insert50-erase50-large
rationale: Larger bucket working set, beyond the 60 MiB LLC; same request count as the smaller churn case.

name: insert100-reserved
rationale: Reserve enough capacity to avoid timed resize; same 134217728 successful insert requests as the growth case.

name: insert100-reserved-long
rationale: The capacity-28, 134M-request reserved control lasted under one second. Increase both capacity and count fourfold; retain the short control separately. This is not a count-matched comparison to the growth case.

name: update100-hot16-recheck
rationale: Initial hot-16 mean was +2.04%, with four of five positive pairs. Retest the same fixed count on fresh seeds, reversing the initial placement order. Do not pool this follow-up into the original result.
